compatibility.rollback: rollback all three packages together to the previous validated exact-version set

routing_corpus.policy: immutable baseline corpus; accepted only because compatibility.migration.from is exactly 1.10.0

handoff.duplicate_policy: same handoff/state is idempotent; content mutation changes handoff_id; invalid duplicate/transition fails closed
handoff.freshness: validated against observed_at and bounded max_age_days
handoff.provenance: source, authority, and non-empty evidence_refs are mandatory

identity.source_package_hash_policy: baseline source hash and final candidate/archive hashes are separate identities; no self-referential in-package tree hash is stored inside the package

privacy.source_lineage_verification: authenticity requires supplied source handoff evidence; declared lineage alone is not proof

recovery.last_known_good: handoff ledger preserves an explicit last-good sidecar before replacing an existing valid ledger
recovery.resume: recovery restores only a structurally valid last-good ledger and emits a receipt
recovery.safe_rerun: idempotent duplicate records do not append events

reproducibility_definition: same supported inputs and environment satisfy the same authority, routing, handoff, validation, recovery, and delivery contracts; natural-language bytes need not be identical

routing.ambiguous_behavior: block mutation until exactly one current owner is resolved
routing.phase_rule: normalize intents -> coalesce adjacent same-owner intents -> prepend resolved current owner when needed -> insert Mago bridge for Nomia->Magia -> derive typed handoffs
routing.route_identity: sha256 over normalized intents/current owner/owner sequence/handoff sequence

runtime_independence.shared_contract_strategy: byte-equivalent local copies validated at release time

state_transitions.governance_closure: Nomia decision plus external release evidence; execution completion alone is insufficient
